subject: Human Evolution
title: Race Is Not Genetic
description: A short lesson to help you apply Race Is Not Genetic.

hook.text: Genetics has confirmed what anthropologists suspected: biological 'races' don't exist as distinct genetic units.

buildup.text: Human genetic variation is clinal—it changes gradually across geography, not in sharp racial boundaries.

discovery.text: Two people from different 'races' can be more genetically similar than two people from the same 'race.'

twist.text: Most human genetic variation (85–95%) exists within populations, not between them.

climax.text: Race is a social category, not a biological one. Genetics has given us the data to prove this definitively.

punchline.text: Our genes don't sort into races. Never did.

quiz.question: What does genetics reveal about the concept of biological race?
options: There are five distinct genetic races
Most variation exists within populations, not between racial groups
